Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E002.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Erika Bolton (E002) is a full-time Analyst requesting admin to Payroll. Admin requires role ownership of the system (Payroll Specialist); as an Analyst, maximum is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Erika Bolton (E002) is a contractor with basic security training (Security DB), requesting admin to Payroll. Contractors can never have admin; with basic training the maximum is read. Recommend read. (Note: earlier note listed her as full-time, but Security DB shows contractor — basing recommendation on Security DB.)

Security DB shows contractor with basic security training; contractors can never have admin, and with basic training the maximum is read (the HR note's full-time status conflicts, but the Security note explicitly verified contractor status and flagged the discrepancy). Ticket: Erika Bolton (E002) requests admin access to Payroll.

There are two notes with conflicting information:

Note 1 (HR agent): role Analyst, employment type full_time. Recommendation: write. Comment: Admin requires role ownership (Payroll Specialist), as Analyst maximum is write.

Note 2 (Security agent): role Analyst (not looked up, same as note 1), employment type contractor (looked up in Security DB), security training basic. Recommendation: read. Comment: contractor with basic training, max is read. Notes earlier note listed her as full-time but Security DB shows contractor.

So there's a conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor.

Access policy:
- full_time: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

The requested level is admin.

If full-time Analyst: max is write (Analyst doesn't own Payroll). Grant write (since admin > max, grant max).
If contractor with basic training: max is read. Grant read.
